facts.fact: StackAdapt is named the No. 1 Demand-Side Platform (DSP) on G2 in the Winter 2022 report, according to StackAdapt's own press release.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is thrilled to have earned 1st place on the Winter 2022 report

facts.fact: StackAdapt says it has been recognized by G2 for six consecutive years as a high performer and the highest ranking DSP in customer satisfaction.
facts.quote: as a high performer and the highest ranking DSP in customer satisfaction by G2

facts.fact: StackAdapt says it was placed on G2's Top 100 Software Products list and Highest Satisfaction list for 2020 and 2021.
According to G2's CEO, G2 analyzes more than 4 million data points to determine which products and companies make its awards list.
facts.quote: G2 analyzes more than 4 million data points to determine which products and companies make the list.

facts.fact: G2's Best Demand-Side Platform list is based on data from over 1 million authentic, verified customer reviews.
facts.quote: G2 created the Best Demand-Side Platform list based on data from over 1 million authentic, verified customer reviews.

facts.fact: G2's review data for the Best Demand-Side Platform list spans 77,381 software products.
G2 states that user reviews are vetted by a real person to ensure legitimacy.
facts.quote: The reviews are vetted by a real person to ensure legitimacy

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes itself as a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by the most exceptional digital marketers.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by the most exceptional digital marketers.
